annotations.title: Set Access Tags on an entry

description: Restrict who can retrieve one knowledge base entry. A visitor must present a matching tag, signed by your own server, before the chatbot will use the entry. Send an empty list to make it public again. Access Tags needs the Enterprise plan.

access_tags.description: Tag names. An empty list makes the entry public.
